files.description: 10-page EHI Export Documentation PDF covering export format (C-CDA + proprietary XML sidecars), directory structure, file types, XML element definitions for documents, office notes, tasks, data lookups, faxes, with enumerator definitions and XML examples.
HTML landing page for the EHI Export documentation. Contains a brief introduction stating C-CDA export format and a link to the PDF.
Full-page screenshot of the EHI Export landing page showing the introduction text and PDF link.
Bun TypeScript extraction script that parses the Export_data.pdf and produces structured JSON of all XML entities, fields, enumerators, and export file definitions.
Machine-queryable JSON extraction of the full export schema: 7 XML entities, 71 fields, 2 enumerators (32 values), 7 exported file types, directory structure, and XML examples.
README documenting how to run the enrichment script, input/output boundaries, and known limitations.
